pages.text: Read the operation intel in the Blacklight dimension. In the indicated Futian sector, look for the black-and-yellow checkpoint. A military disguise lets you inspect dispatch records for the unloading junction and west service entrance.

Alternatively, tail the departing truck from the workshop roof. If you lose it, wait at the post. Investigate its rear while sneaking for circuitry. You can also seize a vehicle or follow the twin tire tracks and hoses on foot.$(br2)$(l:pump)Activate the pump$(/l)
